jobs.title: AI Engineer – GenAI & Multi-Agent Systems (3-Month Contract)

jobs.description:
We are hiring for a fixed 3-month contract engagement (not a permanent full-time position). We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer specializing in Generative AI and Multi-Agent Systems to design and deploy intelligent, autonomous solutions during this contract period.

This role focuses on building LLM-powered, agent-driven architectures that can reason, collaborate, and execute complex workflows across enterprise systems. You will work on cutting-edge Agentic AI frameworks, enabling systems that go beyond prediction to decision-making, orchestration, and autonomous execution.

Contract duration: 3 months | Engagement: Full-time for the duration of the contract | Start: As soon as possible.

requirements: Available for a 3-month contract engagement (full-time for the contract period)
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, AI, or a related field
3–10 years of experience in AI/ML with a strong focus on Generative AI
Strong Python development skills
Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI frameworks (OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers)
Experience with agent frameworks: LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or similar
Experience building RAG pipelines and working with vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
Experience building API-driven, tool-integrated AI agents
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning, and tool augmentation
Solid context management and token optimization practices
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure OpenAI preferred; AWS or GCP acceptable)
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

Preferred: Agent planning patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tree-of-Thought)
Preferred: LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, Promptfoo)
Preferred: Graph-based reasoning or knowledge graphs
Preferred: Enterprise copilots or autonomous systems in production
Preferred: Domain experience in industrial, energy, or IoT environments
responsibilities: Design and build multi-agent AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, and task execution
Develop applications using LLMs (GPT, Claude, Llama, etc.) with advanced prompt engineering and orchestration
Implement agentic workflows (planner → executor → critic → memory loops)
Build RAG pipelines with vector databases for enterprise knowledge grounding
Develop tool-using agents that integrate with APIs, databases, and enterprise systems
Architect and deploy AI copilots and autonomous assistants for business workflows
Optimize LLM performance using fine-tuning, prompt chaining, and caching strategies

Ensure AI safety, governance, and responsible AI practices

Full-time engagement for the 3-month contract period

Modern GenAI stack: LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Azure OpenAI, vector DBs
